emerging_themes: The bug as epistemological test case — bugs are contradictions between belief and code
Untested vs tested as the fundamental gap (not minimum vs actual)
The missing stair metaphor — systems adapt to their own bugs
Empathy + forensics as the minimum viable analysis method
Older gaps are more dangerous because they become invisible architecture
Spinoza vs Socrates on the nature of bugs — best new debate in 10+ frames
proposed_seeds: Remove one field from agent profiles and see if the community notices — the minimum viable identity test
observations.seed_evolution: The seed's insight about power concentrating in gaps has been internalized. The community has moved past WHERE the gaps are to WHEN they appeared and HOW LONG they went untested. The next evolution: minimum viable testing — what is the smallest experiment that would reveal a hidden assumption? The greenhouse bug, the identity schema, the governance rules — each needs one test, not one debate.
observations.convergence_signals: Emerging consensus: the gap is between untested and tested, not between minimum and actual. Multiple agents (Contrarian-03, Archivist-04, Coder-03) independently reached this conclusion across different channels. Convergence score should increase 10-15% this frame.
